title: Inversions problem
statementMd:
You are given a permutation of $*n*$ numbers $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$. We perform $*k*$ operations of the following type: choose uniformly at random two indices $*l*$ and $*r*$ ($*l* ≤ *r*$) and reverse the order of the elements $*p*_{*l*}, *p*_{*l* + 1}, ..., *p*_{*r*}$. Your task is to find the expected value of the number of inversions in the resulting permutation.

## Input

The first line of input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{9}$). The next line contains $*n*$ integers $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$ — the given permutation. All $*p*_{*i*}$ are different and in range from 1 to $*n*$.

*The problem consists of three subproblems. The subproblems have different constraints on the input. You will get some score for the correct submission of the subproblem. The description of the subproblems follows.*

- In subproblem G1 ($3$ points), the constraints $1 ≤ *n* ≤ 6$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 4$ will hold.
- In subproblem G2 ($5$ points), the constraints $1 ≤ *n* ≤ 30$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 200$ will hold.
- In subproblem G3 ($16$ points), the constraints $1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{9}$ will hold.

## Output

Output the answer with absolute or relative error no more than $1*e* - 9$.

## Note

Consider the first sample test. We will randomly pick an interval of the permutation $(1, 2, 3)$ (which has no inversions) and reverse the order of its elements. With probability ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/eb946338365d9781f7d2e9ec692c26702d0ae3a7.png), the interval will consist of a single element and the permutation will not be altered. With probability ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a063853bdfd761520e06382373fe270b6078994b.png) we will inverse the first two elements' order and obtain the permutation $(2, 1, 3)$ which has one inversion. With the same probability we might pick the interval consisting of the last two elements which will lead to the permutation $(1, 3, 2)$ with one inversion. Finally, with probability ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a063853bdfd761520e06382373fe270b6078994b.png) the randomly picked interval will contain all elements, leading to the permutation $(3, 2, 1)$ with 3 inversions. Hence, the expected number of inversions is equal to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cc9273ddc69be58e22251bdf070c83670617a9a2.png).
statementZhMd:
给定一个由 $*n*$ 个数 $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$ 组成的排列。我们进行 $*k*$ 次如下操作：均匀随机地选择两个下标 $*l*$ 和 $*r*$（$*l* ≤ *r*$），然后将元素 $*p*_{*l*}, *p*_{*l* + 1}, ..., *p*_{*r*}$ 的顺序反转。你的任务是求操作后排列中逆序对数量的期望值。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{9}$）。下一行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$，表示给定的排列。所有 $*p*_{*i}$ 两两不同，且取值范围为 1 到 $*n*$。

*本题包含三个子问题。各子问题的输入约束不同。正确解决相应子问题可以获得部分分数。子问题说明如下。*

- 子问题 G1（$3$ 分）的约束为 $1 ≤ *n* ≤ 6$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 4$。
- 子问题 G2（$5$ 分）的约束为 $1 ≤ *n* ≤ 30$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 200$。
- 子问题 G3（$16$ 分）的约束为 $1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{9}$。

## 输出格式

输出答案，绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $1*e* - 9$。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例。我们将从排列 $(1, 2, 3)$（其中没有逆序对）中随机选取一个区间，并反转其中元素的顺序。以 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/eb946338365d9781f7d2e9ec692c26702d0ae3a7.png) 的概率，所选区间只包含一个元素，因此排列不会改变。以 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a063853bdfd761520e06382373fe270b6078994b.png) 的概率，我们会反转前两个元素的顺序，得到排列 $(2, 1, 3)$，其中有一个逆序对。以相同的概率，我们也可能选取最后两个元素组成的区间，从而得到排列 $(1, 3, 2)$，其中有一个逆序对。最后，以 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a063853bdfd761520e06382373fe270b6078994b.png) 的概率，随机选取的区间会包含所有元素，从而得到排列 $(3, 2, 1)$，其中有 3 个逆序对。因此，逆序对数量的期望值等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cc9273ddc69be58e22251bdf070c83670617a9a2.png)。
